systems.tiers: One centre at National Police Headquarters, Nairobi, operational since May 2015: monitors 1,803 CCTV cameras in Nairobi and Mombasa counties, receives all the country's 999, 112 and 911 emergency calls and dispatches them; extension to other towns planned (May 2018)

systems.system: Automatic Number Plate Recognition Control System
systems.tiers: Cameras on major roads and highways, flagging stolen vehicles blacklisted at the command centre; over 1,800 vehicles blacklisted and 720 recovered between May 2015 and December 2017

note: The document describes the police command centre, its cameras, emergency-call dispatch and number-plate recognition, all of class surveillance; it states nothing about how stations record reports or cases.
